controls.name: thresholdDb
controls.doc: The level, dBFS, under which the face starts to lift.

controls.name: ratio
controls.doc: The upward ratio: the lift is (1 - 1/ratio) of the distance under the threshold. 1 lifts nothing and is the input, bit for bit, the come-up value.

controls.name: rangeDb
controls.doc: The largest lift, dB: a signal far under the threshold, the room's noise included, rises by this and no more.

controls.name: attackMs
controls.doc: How fast the detector follows a rise, ms; a rise takes the lift away.

controls.name: releaseMs
controls.doc: How fast the detector follows a fall, ms; a fall brings the lift in.

readouts.name: gainDb
readouts.doc: What the block's loudest sample rose by, dB: 0 while nothing is lifted.

UPWARD_KNEE_DB.doc: The face's knee, dB, across the threshold: the lift eases in rather than starting on a corner.
